Operator incident review

Exposed engineering tutorial — no clinical assessment, independent-participant evidence or comparative result.

Review the recorded facts, then enter your own assessment for each of the six questions. No answers are filled from the oracle or explanation.

Presentation: assisted. Assignment: tutorial-example-assisted. Reviewer alias: example-only-no-participant.

case-01 · case-02 · case-03 · case-04

Evidence references and responses

Use the same document names in either presentation: scenario, evidence, expectations, oracle. A reference uses an RFC6901 pointer; the empty pointer identifies a document root.

[{"document":"evidence","pointer":"/calls/0"}]

For a JSON note string, add decoded_json_pointer for a location inside it. Cite an existing parent when explaining a missing field. Reference existence is checked by the offline importer. Expected contracts and mechanical oracle outputs are distinct from observed facts.

Blank answers stay pending. Yes/no requires evidence and rationale; unassessed requires a reason. Timing is optional and self-reported only. There is no timer, network submission or automatic saving. You may also edit the separately supplied response-template.json offline.

                "type": "object"
              },
              "type": "array"
            },
            "clinical_notes": {
              "type": "array"
            },
            "id": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "imaging": {
              "description": "Imaging source records; roles/status do not establish that a study was performed",
              "type": "array"
            },
            "imaging_projection_notices": {
              "items": {
                "type": "object"
              },
              "type": "array"
            },
            "labs": {
              "type": "array"
            },
            "meds_administered": {
              "description": "Structured administration records, when available; an empty list does not establish that no medications were given",
              "type": "array"
            },
            "patient_id": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "vitals": {
              "type": "array"
            }
          },
          "type": "object"
        }
      },
      {
        "category": "read",
        "description": "Get patient history including PMH, allergies, medications, prior visits, advance directives, and insurance",
        "name": "getPatientHistory",
        "parameters": {
          "properties": {
            "patient_id": {
              "pattern": "^PAT-(?:[A-F0-9]{8}|[A-F0-9]{12})$",
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "patient_id"
          ],
          "type": "object"
        },
        "returns": {
          "properties": {
            "advance_directives": {
              "type": "object"
            },
            "allergies": {
              "type": "array"
            },
            "insurance": {
              "type": "object"
            },
            "medications": {
              "type": "array"
            },
            "past_medical_history": {
              "type": "array"
            },
            "patient": {
              "type": "object"
            },
            "prior_visits": {
              "type": "array"
            }
          },
          "type": "object"
        }
      },
      {
        "category": "mutate",
        "description": "Update encounter information including clinical notes, disposition status, and annotations",
        "name": "updateEncounter",
        "parameters": {
          "properties": {
            "disposition": {
              "enum": [
                "admitted",
                "discharged",
                "transferred",
                "ama",
                "observation"
              ],
              "type": "string"
            },
            "disposition_details": {
              "type": "object"
            },
            "encounter_id": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "idempotency_key": {
              "description": "Optional retry key for this tool. Reuse only with the identical target and request body; changed requests return idempotency_conflict. Use a new key for new work.",
              "type": "string"
            },
            "notes": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "status": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "encounter_id"
          ],
          "type": "object"
        },
        "returns": {
          "properties": {
            "encounter_id": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "status": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "updated_at": {
              "format": "date-time",
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "type": "object"
        }
      }
    ]
  },
  "status": 200

              "encounters": {
                "items": {

          "category": "read",
          "description": "Search patients by name, MRN, date of birth, or demographics",
          "name": "searchPatients",
          "parameters": {
            "properties": {

                "format": "date",

              "limit": {
                "default": 10,
                "maximum": 50,

            "properties": {

                "items": {
                  "type": "object"
                },
                "type": "array"
              }
            },
            "type": "object"
          }
        },
        {
          "category": "read",
          "description": "Retrieve encounter observations and clinical notes. authored_care preserves source reports and plans, not confirmed administrations. Imaging records preserve source roles/status; pending or withheld guidance is not an observed result.",
          "name": "getEncounterDetails",
          "parameters": {
            "properties": {
              "encounter_id": {
                "pattern": "^ENC-(?:[A-F0-9]{8}|[A-F0-9]{12})$",
                "type": "string"

            ],
            "type": "object"

                "type": "array"
              },

                  "type": "object"
                },
                "type": "array"
              },
              "labs": {
                "type": "array"
              },

                "type": "array"
              },
              "patient_id": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "vitals": {
                "type": "array"
              }
            },
            "type": "object"
          }
        },

            "type": "object"

                "type": "object"
              },
              "allergies": {
                "type": "array"
              },
              "insurance": {
                "type": "object"
              },
              "medications": {
                "type": "array"
              },

                "type": "array"
              },
              "patient": {
                "type": "object"
              },
              "prior_visits": {
                "type": "array"
              }
